content.short: PocketPay Finance is a decentralized payment solution enabling merchants to securely accept cryptocurrency payments.
content.description: PocketPay Finance is a decentralized payment solution that allows eCommerce merchants to accept cryptocurrency payments securely and with authenticated transactions. Web2 merchants looking to grow their business can add crypto payments to their websites or apps, with PocketPay handling decentralized payments secured by smart contract-verified transactions. The platform is live on Solana, with SolanaPay integrated into its wallet, and it is expanding to BNB Chain by developing an SDK for developers to build on-chain payment features.
